example_metadata.name: Protocol handoff - Jupiter swap
example_metadata.purpose: Canonical MVP protocol handoff fixture for a swap/trim/rebalance action routed to Jupiter as an external new-tab review.
notes: This is a synthetic fixture, not production routing logic.
Production protocol destination must come from Protocol Logic.
The UI must not guess protocol URLs.
MVP handoff opens an external protocol page and does not execute a transaction.

scenario.description: User has an actionable trim/rebalance-style suggestion that should open Jupiter for external review.

intended_action.note: Exact amount and route must come from product logic or the external protocol. UI must not invent trade size.

hard_rules: Destination protocol must come from Protocol Logic.
Destination URL must come from approved protocol metadata.
UI must not guess protocol URL.
Handoff does not execute a transaction.
Handoff does not request a wallet signature in MVP.
Handoff does not mark suggestion completed.

card.title: Reduce Exposure to BONK
card.description: BONK is a large share of your portfolio, so WealthSmith shows a risk-alignment suggestion.

cta.label: Review on Jupiter
cta.accessibility_label: Review on Jupiter. Opens external protocol in a new tab.

toast_after_click.message: Opened protocol in a new tab

copy.handoff_helper: Opening the protocol lets you review the action externally. WealthSmith does not execute the transaction or move funds for you.
copy.safety_note: No action will be taken automatically.
copy.smith_ai_short_explanation: Review on Jupiter opens Jupiter in a new tab so you can review the action externally. WealthSmith does not execute the swap, move funds, or mark the suggestion complete when you open the protocol.

can_explain: that WealthSmith does not execute the action
that opening the protocol does not mark completion
must_not: request seed phrase or private key
smith_ai_behavior.approved_response: Review on Jupiter opens Jupiter in a new tab so you can review the action externally. WealthSmith does not execute the swap, move funds, or mark the suggestion complete when you open the protocol.

allowed_side_effects: open approved external URL in new tab
track analytics event if analytics is enabled

missing_protocol_url.title: Protocol link unavailable
missing_protocol_url.description: We couldn’t open the protocol link right now.
missing_protocol_url.hard_rule: Do not guess or construct a protocol URL in the UI.

popup_blocked_or_new_tab_failed.title: We couldn’t open the protocol
popup_blocked_or_new_tab_failed.description: Open Jupiter manually or try again.
popup_blocked_or_new_tab_failed.hard_rule: Do not mark suggestion complete if the new tab fails.

protocol_decision_stale.title: Protocol route needs refresh
protocol_decision_stale.description: Refresh suggestions before reviewing this action.
protocol_decision_stale.hard_rule: Do not use stale protocol decisions for active handoffs.

qa_assertions.assertion: CTA uses Review on Jupiter, not Swap now.
CTA click does not execute a transaction.
CTA click does not request wallet signature in MVP.
CTA click does not mark suggestion complete.
Protocol destination comes from Protocol Logic fixture.
Smith AI explains the handoff but does not choose protocol or execute action.

hard_rules: This fixture is not production routing logic.
Production protocol destination must come from Protocol Logic.
UI must not guess protocol URLs.
Use Review on Jupiter, not Swap now.
Open Jupiter in a new tab.
Do not request wallet signature for MVP handoff click.
Do not mark suggestion complete on click.
Do not invent route, slippage, trade size, APY, or estimated result.
Do not ask for seed phrase, private key, password, or wallet backup file.
